coverage.main: Read all thirty-five pages of arXiv 2010.04055 (ICLR 2021 content): Sections 1-6, Tables 1-4, Figures 1-3, references and Appendices A-M (Shapley background, proofs, interaction tables 5 and 11, computational cost Table 6, leave-one-out evaluation (Appendix K), MI/SGM/VR+IR Tables 7-9, targeted Table 10, lambda sweeps Figures 8-9).
coverage.supplement: Appendices are embedded in the arXiv PDF and read.
coverage.excluded_results: Interaction measurements (Tables 5, 11; Figure 2) and proofs are not transfer rates; white-box cells are excluded.

result_groups.locator: Section 5 (p. 8); Tables 1, 2, 4; Figure 3; Appendix K; Tables 7-10; Figures 8-9
result_groups.population: 1,000 randomly selected ImageNet validation images; six single sources and an ensemble; normally trained targets; three random repetitions
result_groups.outcome: Transferability = E_i[1[C(x_hat_i) != y_i]] over all N clean examples, where each example's step t* is chosen by leave-one-out success on the target over the other N-1 examples (Appendix K)
result_groups.evidence: The average is explicitly over all N clean examples, with no clean-correct or source-success filter. The leave-one-out step selection uses target-model predictions on the other images; this is recorded as an evaluation design choice, not as population conditioning.

result_groups.population: Same images; attacks transferred to adversarially trained (secured) models; LOO not used
result_groups.evidence: The metric without LOO is not defined.

result_groups.population: 50 random ImageNet validation images; ResNet-to-DenseNet and DenseNet-to-ResNet transfer
result_groups.outcome: transfer utility (target logit margin) correlated with interaction
result_groups.evidence: A continuous margin outcome; no population rule stated.

f2.evidence: The LOO scope includes all examples (no); the other scopes are unresolved.

f3.evidence: The LOO scope includes all examples (no); the other scopes are unresolved.

f4.evidence: Values are means ± std over three repetitions.

f5.evidence: L-infinity epsilon = 16/255 and L2 epsilon = 16/255 x sqrt(n) for all attacks.

f6.evidence: Code is linked (github.com/xherdan76/A-Unified-Approach-to-Interpreting-and-Boosting-Adversarial-Transferability); the sampled images and checkpoints were not verified. Not executed.

artifact_checks.result: Repository linked in the paper; not listed, cloned or executed.

bounds_checks.reason: The LOO population is unconditional, but no clean error on the same 1,000 images is reported, and the target-informed step selection means the reported rate is not a fixed-attack transfer probability.

limitations: Non-blind evidence audit. The target-informed leave-one-out step selection is recorded for the manuscript's discussion of evaluation choices; it is not described as an error.
